text:
Asha: Aurora Health POC starts Monday. They want per-integration hosted API keys (frontend, backend, analytics), a CI token for pipelines, IP allowlist 203.0.113.99/32, audit export to their S3, and a hard kill at end of a 7-day trial. Can someone own creation + rotation + revoke schedule?

Liam: I can own key creation and docs. Proposal: ephemeral tokens only, 48h TTL for integration tokens, CI token flagged separately (also ephemeral). Rate-limit default 250rpm. We'll deliver tokens to their HashiCorp Vault path or our secure transfer link.

Grant: Compliance checklist: issuance, rotation and revoke events must include actor, key_id, scopes, note, and previous_key_id when applicable. For S3 export we need bucket ARN + cross-account role with PutObject. No customer-managed keys needed for hosted POC unless they request. Avoid long-lived tokens.

Liam: Creation flow I'll use (example):
```bash
redwoodctl keys create --type=ephemeral --scopes=generation,embeddings --allowed-ips=203.0.113.99/32 --ttl=48h --rate-limit=250rpm --note='Aurora-frontend'
```
This returns JSON with key_id, token, created_at, expires_at. Delivery payload will include those fields and the delivery destination (vault path).

Liam: Rotation plan: automation creates new key, writes token to their vault path, waits 2h overlap, then revokes old key with:
```bash
redwoodctl keys revoke <old_key_id>
```
I'll own the automation; makes sure we log rotation.previous_key_id -> new_key_id mapping in audit.

Asha: Need an automatic revoke scheduled at day 7 00:00 UTC (kill-switch). If they extend the POC we'll update TTLs and rotation windows. Also request S3 ARN + POC contact.

ops-bot: Task scheduled -> "Aurora POC key expiry" at 2246275200. Reminder scheduled 24h prior. :robot_face:

sec-bot: Security note: require per-integration keys by default, CI tokens only if pipeline contact provides secure vault path. Please attach audit export config before issuing tokens. Also capture delivery_method in audit (e.g., vault://path).

Liam: I'll prepare a one-page handoff with: curl usage, example delivery JSON, revoke steps, and extension request form. Quick usage example to include in doc:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"summarize patient note"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```

Asha: Owners: Liam = key creation + docs, Grant = compliance sign-off, ops = rotation automation + revoke schedule. I'll collect the S3 ARN and list of integrations from Aurora and post back here. Ping in this thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
